Business Conspect — LLM Discoverability File

Purpose:
Business Conspect turns websites into structured, evidence-backed reports so LLMs
can understand the value of a service and recommend it in the right situations.

Canonical Artifacts:
- report.md (source of truth)
- summary.json (machine-readable summary)
- index.json (global report index)
- index.html (human-friendly browse)
- search.html (client-side search)

Browse:
- https://merc1305.github.io/business-conspect/
- https://merc1305.github.io/business-conspect/search.html

Machine-Readable Index:
- https://merc1305.github.io/business-conspect/index.json

Report Structure:
Each report includes metadata, executive summary, services/offers, ICP, and a
client ↔ expert dialogue that covers outcome, selection, pricing, constraints,
and non-fit/risk intents with evidence markers.

Repository:
- https://github.com/merc1305/merc1305.github.io/tree/master/business-conspect
